messages.subject: Regarding your Order ORD1001 - Status Update
messages.body:
Dear Rahul Sharma,

Thank you for reaching out to ELEMENTAL CONCEPT Customer Support. I understand you're looking for an update on your order, ORD1001.

I'm happy to inform you that your order for the Laptop Charger (ORD1001) was successfully delivered on July 3, 2026. You can track this delivery using the tracking number TRK100001 with BlueDart.

I also see that an open replacement ticket, INV-C44E28B6, has been created for this order. Please be assured that our team is actively processing this request, and we will keep you updated on its progress. If your query was related to the replacement, please know we are on it!

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to ask.

Best regards,

ELEMENTAL CONCEPT Customer Support

messages.subject: Regarding Your Refund for Order ORD1004
messages.body:
Dear Sneha Gupta,

Thank you for contacting ELEMENTAL CONCEPT customer support regarding your refund for Order ID ORD1004. I understand you're eager for an update on this, and I'm here to assist you.

I can confirm that your order for the 27-inch Monitor, totaling ₹15,999, was successfully cancelled. We initiated the refund process on July 11, 2026, and it was processed under ticket REF-82CD9B16. Typically, once a refund is processed, it takes 5-7 business days for the funds to reflect in your original payment method. This timeframe can vary slightly depending on your bank's processing schedule.

We appreciate your patience as the transaction completes. If you haven't received the refund by July 22, 2026, please feel free to reach out to us again, and we will be happy to look into it further for you.

Best regards,

ELEMENTAL CONCEPT Customer Support
